title: Image gallery
summary: A grid of square thumbnails with one marked primary (a badge and an accent frame). Clicking a thumbnail opens the lightbox. Editable, it adds a make-primary and a remove button under each image, a drag handle (or Alt+Up/Alt+Down) to reorder them, and an add tile that picks files.

props.name: images
props.description: The images: [{ src, alt, primary?, status? }]. status is a short warning badge such as Staged. Property or a JSON attribute. Only same-site paths, http(s) and raster data URLs are shown.

props.name: primary
props.description: The index of the primary image; -1 uses the first image flagged primary in images, or none.

props.name: columns
props.description: A fixed number of equal columns (1 to 12). 0 fits as many as min allows.

props.name: min
props.description: The narrowest a thumbnail may get, as a css length in px, rem or em. Used when columns is 0.

props.name: editable
props.description: Show make-primary and remove buttons under each image and the add tile.

props.name: accept
props.description: The file types the add tile's picker offers.

events.name: pk-primary-change
events.description: Make primary was pressed. Cancelable: preventDefault keeps the current primary (a controlled gallery updates images and primary itself).

events.name: pk-remove
events.description: Remove was pressed. Cancelable: preventDefault keeps the image. Otherwise it is taken out of images, and if it was the primary the first image becomes the primary.

events.name: pk-add
events.description: Files were chosen on the add tile. The gallery adds nothing itself: read the files (a data URL) and set images.

events.name: pk-reorder
events.description: A tile was dragged by its handle to a new position, or moved with Alt+Up/Alt+Down (built on pk-sortable, core/elements/sortable/). order is every image's src in the new order; item is the moved image's src; from and to are its old and new index. Cancelable: preventDefault keeps the current order (a controlled gallery reorders images itself).

parts.name: tile
parts.description: One thumbnail with its badges and buttons.

parts.name: status
parts.description: The status badge (Staged and the like).

parts.name: actions
parts.description: The row of buttons under an image.

parts.name: add-tile
parts.description: The list item holding the add tile.

parts.name: add
parts.description: The add tile (a label around the file input).

parts.name: add-icon
parts.description: The plus on the add tile.

parts.name: add-text
parts.description: The text on the add tile.

cssProperties.name: --pk-image-gallery-radius
cssProperties.description: Corner radius of the thumbnails and the add tile.

methods.name: view(index)
methods.description: Opens the lightbox at an image.

methods.name: makePrimary(index)
methods.description: Marks an image primary, as the button does (raises pk-primary-change first).

methods.name: removeImage(index)
methods.description: Removes an image, as the button does (raises pk-remove first).

methods.name: reorder(from, to)
methods.description: Moves an image to a new index, as a drag or Alt+Up/Alt+Down does (raises pk-reorder first).

a11y: The grid is a list (pk-sortable, role=list). Each thumbnail is a button that opens the lightbox (Enter or Space); its name is the image's alt text. Make primary and Remove name their image ("Remove: Back view"). Editable, each tile is also a pk-sortable-item (role=listitem): its handle drags to reorder, or Alt+Up/Alt+Down on the focused tile moves it and announces the new position through a visually-hidden live region. The add tile is a real file input, reachable and operable by keyboard, with a visible focus ring. After a removal focus moves to the next image, or the add tile when none is left. Primary and status are text badges, never colour alone.
mobile: Thumbnails wrap to as many columns as fit (three at 375px with the default min); the buttons, the add tile and the drag handle are 44px high, and there is no hover step (Alt+Up/Alt+Down reorders without a drag).
